question_title: How many mass shootings will the U.S. experience in August 2026?
summary: Forecasting August 2026 US mass shootings per the Mass Shooting Tracker (MST, broadest 4+-shot-including-shooter definition). I pulled authoritative monthly counts directly from MST's S3 JSON data. 2026 monthly: Jan34, Feb36, Mar43, Apr42, May48, Jun45, Jul74 (partial through Jul 27). Recent Augusts declined sharply: 2023=68, 2024=61, 2025=46. 2026 YTD (322) runs ~7% above the comparable 2025 period. A Monte Carlo mixture of three estimation approaches — year-over-year scaling (~50), July-to-August ratio (~0.76 × ~79 full-July ≈ 60), and continued-decline trend (~44) — centers August 2026 near 51, mode in the 46-55 bucket with substantial mass on adjacent buckets. Genuine uncertainty from the low-June/high-July tension, but August's lack of a major holiday favors reversion toward the low-50s.

revision_history.reviewer_assessment:
The forecast is well-grounded and the probability is well-calibrated. I verified all four factors against the trace and found no hallucination, double-counting, wrong-direction, or resolution-misalignment errors. One tool-audit accuracy issue warrants a warn, but it does not affect the forecast.

WHAT I CHECKED AND CONFIRMED:

1. Evidence grounding — All factor numbers trace to authoritative data. The agent found the MST S3 JSON bucket (mass-shooting-tracker-data.s3.us-east-2.amazonaws.com/{year}-data.json) via sandbox HTML inspection, then fetched and parsed it directly. Every figure is verified in-trace: Aug 2025=46, Aug trend 68/61/46 (F2), July 2026=74 through Jul 27 with Jul→Aug ratio ~0.76 (F3), 2026 monthly Jan34/Feb36/Mar43/Apr42/May48/Jun45 running below 2025, and the no-August-holiday reversion logic (F4). No fabricated claims.

2. Factor directions — All logit signs match descriptions. F1/F4 push toward 46-55, F3 toward 56-65, F2 toward ≤45. Consistent with the Monte Carlo mixture.

3. Resolution criteria — Present and directly engaged. Question resolves on the MST August 2026 count; the agent used exactly that source and mapped every historical August into the exact option buckets. No misalignment.

4. Regime contamination — The Monte Carlo (YoY scaling ≈49.5, July-ratio ≈60.2, trend-continuation ≈44) uses recent 2023-2026 data and appropriately down-weights the 2020-21 pandemic-era Augusts (84/82). The drift is not contaminated by the pandemic regime.

5. Probability check (independent) — My own estimate lands in the same place. Central tendency ~50-52 (2026 below 2025, Aug 2025=46, declining trend, full July ~79 × 0.76 ratio). The distribution centered ~51 with ≤45=29%, 46-55=33.5%, 56-65=24% is reasonable. The tentative probabilities match the Monte Carlo output nearly exactly (46-55: 0.336→33.5%). No meaningful divergence — no fail.

6. Anchor divergence — Anchor median 52; final center ~51 sits right at the anchor. No unjustified departure.

7. Counterargument — Genuinely strong. It constructs the coherent "summer running hot, July surge carries into August (2024 ratio 0.87), upper buckets under-weighted" alternative AND the downside low-40s case. Not a token gesture.

8. Self-confidence 0.60 — Well-calibrated given real month-to-month volatility (June 45 vs July 74).
